about.label: About
about.pull: You are not hiring an agency, an account manager or a rotating team. You are hiring the person who writes the code.
about.p1: By day I am a senior software engineer and application architect at HTEC, building a mobile health application in Angular and Ionic. The six years before that were at CertiCon, the last of them as software architect, leading Angular platforms for Bosch and Medtronic. Alongside all of it I have taken my own client work since 2015.
about.p2: Practically, that means someone who has shipped inside regulated medical software and also alone on a weekend release. Same care, different paperwork.
